text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#9876 - router-p95 > 450ms (threshold 300ms) in us-east-1. auto-escalation scheduled in 2m if unacked.
Tim: acked. taking first look. any obvious customer impact?
Lee: looking at traces now — brief spike across a subset of proxies, topology region=us-east-1, not global.
Lee: dashboard here: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/routers/overview?panelId=12 (p95) — spike is tight ~40s window, then back to baseline
Jaya: I saw a canary rollout earlier that was retrying on a bad build, it bumped traffic to a different path. suspect canary churn causing route pressure.
Tim: good call. @jaya can you pause canary or route it away?
Jaya: pausing now, pushed route-pin to stable with: 
```
redwoodctl rollout pause --canary canary-2026-03-15
redwoodctl routing set-pin --service router --to stable
```
Jaya: done. canary traffic drained in ~20s.
Morgan: grabbing logs from affected proxies to confirm error churn: `kubectl logs -l app=router-proxy -n prod --tail=200`
Tim: sanity check on customer impact: SLO alerts? any 500s?
Lee: 5xxs didn't move much, error rate stayed within normal band. mostly elevated latency traces with a few retry chains.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: acknowledged by Tim. escalation timer canceled.
Tim: silencing this alert source for 10m while we watch — `pagerctl mute PD#9876 --duration 10m`
Jaya: canary rollback also queued; we'll roll forward a fix tomorrow.
Morgan: FYI I see follower spikes in KV cache fills — likely from the retry chain causing duplicate reads. warming/prewarmed caches helped drop the p95 back down.
Lee: metrics back to baseline across region. I think auto-resolve will close the PD soon.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved (closed) at root cause tuned down.
Tim: quick postmortem notes: small canary retry caused transient routing pressure -> p95 spike. no customer visible errors, short-lived. Actions: 1) add suppression for canary churn as signal (ops rule) 2) improve canary health checks to fail faster, 3) add KV prewarm during heavy rollouts.
Jaya: filed follow-up ticket: RW-1482 (suppress noisy canary, tighten healthcheck).
Morgan: leaving a watch for next 30m, then handing off to oncall-2.
Tim: handing off to Lee for the rest of the night — Lee, take it if you want to keep an eye on trends.
Lee: taking it. will monitor 30m and unmute if it flares. :thumbsup:
Tim: thanks — closing thread unless it resurfaces.
incident-bot: PD note: no customer-impact tag. auto-notes attached: canary-id=canary-2026-03-15, region=us-east-1, duration=~80s.
